structure: Part 13, Check your answers: the live-animals review page (page id and slug notification-view) in repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend at main 4c2119da. Read in full: features/check-answers/page.js, controller.js (GET renders the review, POST refuses or moves on), refusal.js (the shared refusal predicate also used by the declaration submit), template.njk (banner, error summary, h1, copy/delete buttons, cancel-amendment link, sections, groups, cards, identifier table, documents, Continue form), copy/copy.en.js (all English copy, quoted here) and copy/copy.cy.js (Welsh, read for parity only: same key tree, header marks it a machine draft), and every non-test file of view-model/: index.js (six sections in order), invalid-parties.js, applicability.js, incomplete-cards.js (REVIEW_CARDS, card errors, blanking), sections/ (about-consignment, description-of-goods, transport-and-arrival, documents, consignment-parties, contact-address), rows/ (change-link, summary-row, value-text, party-row), cards/documents.js, cards/movement/ (arrival-details, transit-countries, transport-details), cards/addresses/ (roles-and-addresses, contact-address), cards/consignment/ (import-details, reason-for-import, additional-animal-details) and cards/consignment/species/ (species-cards, species-card-title, species-card-rows, species-card-actions, species-text, identifier-table, identifier-columns, identifier-cell, units-for-commodity-line). Also read check-answers.fit.spec.js in full: 22 tests in 8 describe blocks (summary rows 2, section structure 3, documents section 1, exit answers 3, change links 2, navigation and submission 3, unfinished notification 5, submitted notification 2), each claimed. Looked up outside the slice only to resolve what this page shows: the documents feature's someRejected and someStillScanning copy, the order of PARTIES in addresses/parties.js, and the review section of flow/flow.js. Claims cover the page route and back link, heading, the six numbered sections and their anchors, the ten subsection headings, every card with its title, rows, value formats, conditional rows and its one Change link destination, species cards with their titles and identifier table, the documents card and its empty line, party rows with Edit details links and invalid-address messages, the Not applicable versus Missing treatment, incomplete-card messages and anchors, the error summary ordering, the refusal conditions, the read-only (submitted) and amend variants, and the cancel-amendment success banner.

claims.statement: The review ends with a 'Continue' button and nothing between the last card and the button: no heading and no sentence.
Pressing Continue on a notification that is not ready (any hub task row not ready) is refused: the review is shown again with status 400 and the error summary focused.
Continue is refused while any answered party's copied address breaks the address-book rules.
Continue is refused while any card holds a stale stored answer.
Continue is refused while any uploaded document is rejected or still being scanned.
A submitted notification is never refused.
The same refusal check guards the declaration submit, so a bookmark or the back button cannot get a stale notification past the review; on refusal the declaration sends the trader back to the review.
claims.quote:
Shared refusal predicate for the review page's Continue and the
 * declaration submit — a bookmark or back-button cannot sneak a stale
 * submission past.

claims.statement: Pressing Continue on a notification that passes every check moves the trader to the next page in the review section, the declaration.
claims.quote: return h.redirect(nextInSection(page.id, scope, journey.journeyId))
claims.note: The next page is the declaration because flow.js lists the review section as [notificationViewPage, declarationPage, confirmationPage]; the fit spec's submitted-notification setup presses Continue and then meets the declaration checkbox.

claims.statement: The error summary takes focus only after the trader has just been refused; a plain visit keeps focus away from it.
claims.quote:
Focus is only moved to the summary when the user has just been refused, so a
 * plain visit does not yank the caret out of the page heading.

claims.statement: The Continue form posts with a CSRF crumb and the notification's concurrency token.
claims.quote:
<input type="hidden" name="crumb" value="{{ crumb }}" />
      <input type="hidden" name="concurrencyToken" value="{{ concurrencyToken }}" />

claims.statement: A submitted notification's review is read-only: no Continue button, no form, and the page ends with the last card.
claims.quote: A submitted notification is a record, not a form.

claims.statement: A submitted notification's review shows no unfinished-card, stale-answer, rejected-document or party-address errors.
claims.quote:
// A submitted notification is a record of what was sent, so nothing on it
  // is outstanding, and no stored answer of its is named as stale either

claims.statement: A submitted notification's review shows a secondary button to copy the notification, posting to the notification's copy route with copy origin 'notification-view'.
claims.quote: <input type="hidden" name="copyOrigin" value="notification-view" />
claims.note: Button text comes from shared copy notificationActions.copy.text, outside this slice.

claims.statement: A submitted notification's review shows a warning button to delete it, linking to the notification's delete page.
claims.quote:
deleteHref:
      readOnly && journey.status === state.SUBMITTED
        ? pagePath(journey.journeyId, 'delete')
        : null,
claims.note: Button text comes from shared copy notificationActions.delete.text, outside this slice.

claims.statement: While a notification is being amended, the review shows a 'Cancel amendment' link to the cancel-amend page.
claims.quote: link: 'Cancel amendment',

claims.statement: After an amendment is cancelled (submitted notification with ?cancelled=1), the review shows a success notification banner titled 'Success' reading 'The amendment has been cancelled and the submitted version restored.'
claims.quote:
successTitle: 'Success',
    successBody:
      'The amendment has been cancelled and the submitted version restored.'

claims.statement: A notification being amended (not yet resubmitted) is editable on the review, with Change links and Continue, because only SUBMITTED status makes it read-only.
claims.quote: const readOnly = journey.status === state.SUBMITTED

claims.statement: The review page's Welsh copy has the same keys as the English and is a machine draft not reviewed by a translator.
claims.quote: // MACHINE-DRAFT Welsh — not reviewed by a translator. Do not ship user-facing without Welsh Language Standards sign-off.

claims.statement: Fit test 'renders entered and missing answers in their summary rows' proves that after answering the origin page (France, region code required Yes, region code IDF75, internal reference ReviewRef1) the review shows heading 'Review your notification', section '1. About the consignment', Country of origin France, Region of origin code required Yes, Region of origin code FR-IDF75, Internal reference number ReviewRef1, and arrival date marked Missing.
claims.quote: await expect(rowFor(page, copy.rows.regionCode)).toContainText('FR-IDF75')

claims.statement: Fit test 'journey with only the entry page answered writes the settled blanks out and marks the outstanding ones' proves a new notification's blank internal reference reads 'Not applicable' while the blank arrival date is marked Missing with no 'Not applicable'.
claims.quote: test('journey with only the entry page answered writes the settled blanks out and marks the outstanding ones'
claims.note: This implies a new notification's Import details card counts as finished from the entry page alone.

claims.statement: Fit test 'numbers the six sections in order' proves the six numbered h2 section headings appear in order on a new notification.
claims.quote: test('numbers the six sections in order'

claims.statement: Fit test 'ends with the Continue button and nothing above it' proves the last h2 is '6. Contact address', the last block in the main column is the form, the element just before it is a summary card, and the form holds the Continue button.
claims.quote: test('ends with the Continue button and nothing above it'

claims.statement: Fit test 'heads every card with its own subsection heading' proves a new notification shows exactly these h3 headings in order: 'Where is this consignment coming from?', 'Main reason for import', 'Additional details', 'Arrival details', 'Transport details', 'Upload documents', 'Roles and addresses', 'Contact address for this consignment', and as many h4 headings as summary cards.
claims.quote: test('heads every card with its own subsection heading'
claims.note: So on a new notification neither the Commodity details nor the Transit countries group stands.

claims.statement: Fit test 'shows the documents section and a Change route with nothing uploaded' proves the '4. Documents' heading, the 'Uploaded documents' card and 'You have not added any documents yet.' show with nothing uploaded, and the Change link opens /accompanying-documents?change=1.
claims.quote: test('shows the documents section and a Change route with nothing uploaded'

claims.statement: Fit test 'shows the destination country and port of exit a transit collected, with the one Change link in the card heading' proves a transit reason with port GB DVR and destination IE reads back 'Ireland' and 'Port of Dover (GB DVR)', shows no Exit date row, has no link on the row, and the card's Change link opens /import-reason?change=1.
claims.quote: test('shows the destination country and port of exit a transit collected, with the one Change link in the card heading'

claims.statement: Fit test 'shows the exit date and port of exit a temporary admission collected' proves a temporary admission (horses) reason reads back Exit date 27/3/2026 and Port of exit 'Port of Dover (GB DVR)', with no Destination country row.
claims.quote: test('shows the exit date and port of exit a temporary admission collected'

claims.statement: Fit test 'leaves all three rows off the review for a reason that asks none of them' proves a re-entry reason shows none of Destination country, Exit date or Port of exit.
claims.quote: test('leaves all three rows off the review for a reason that asks none of them'

claims.statement: Fit test 'Change link threads context and returns to the same review after saving' proves the Import details Change link opens /origin?change=1, and saving there returns to /notifications/{id}/notification-view with the cleared internal reference now reading 'Not applicable'.
claims.quote: test('Change link threads context and returns to the same review after saving'

claims.statement: Fit test 'every Change link sits in a card heading and no summary row carries one' proves the count of 'Change' links equals the number of summary cards, no summary-list row actions exist, and each card has exactly one action link.
claims.quote: test('every Change link sits in a card heading and no summary row carries one'

claims.statement: Fit test 'back link returns to the notification hub' proves the review's Back link opens the notification hub.
claims.quote: test('back link returns to the notification hub'

claims.statement: The review page has no serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA axe violations in three states: a new notification, an unfinished notification after a refused Continue, and a submitted notification.
claims.quote: test('review has no serious or critical axe violations'

claims.statement: Fit test 'new journey shows no address error before a role has been answered' proves on a new notification the Consignor row is marked Missing and no 'Correct the address details for the consignor' link appears.
claims.quote: test('new journey shows no address error before a role has been answered'

claims.statement: Fit test 'gives every blank row in a marked card no text and a hidden Missing' proves the unfinished Arrival details card contains no 'Not applicable' and its blank rows read 'Missing' to assistive technology.
claims.quote: test('gives every blank row in a marked card no text and a hidden Missing'

claims.statement: Fit test 'names every unfinished card and marks the card it names' proves a new notification shows 'There is a problem', a 'Complete arrival details' entry linking to #arrival-details, the same message inside that card with the 'Error:' prefix, and the card's error class.
claims.quote: test('names every unfinished card and marks the card it names'

claims.statement: Fit test 'refuses Continue and keeps the trader on the review page' proves pressing Continue on a new notification stays on the review URL and shows the error summary.
claims.quote: test('refuses Continue and keeps the trader on the review page'

claims.statement: Fit test 'refuses submit of a notification with no commodity line and names the missing species details' proves Continue with no commodity line stays on the review and shows a 'Complete species details' entry linking to #description-of-the-goods.
claims.quote: test('refuses submit of a notification with no commodity line and names the missing species details'

claims.statement: Fit test 'ends with the last card and offers no way to submit again' proves that a notification completed, reviewed, declared and then opened from the dashboard's View link shows 'Review your notification' with the copy button and no Continue button.
claims.quote: test('ends with the last card and offers no way to submit again'
claims.note: The setup shows a submitted notification is viewed from the dashboard through this same review page.

claims.statement: No fit test covers the review with a commodity line entered: species cards, their titles, rows, Change link or the identifier table are not exercised end to end in this spec.
claims.note: Looked through all 22 tests; only the submitted-notification setup completes commodities (via completeAnswerSections) and it asserts nothing about species cards.

claims.statement: No fit test covers party address errors being shown (an answered party whose address breaks the rules), the Edit details link, the rejected or still-scanning document errors, the cancel-amendment link or banner, or the delete button on a submitted notification.
